kind: current decision reconstructed from inspected work; no invented earlier history
objective: Develop new computational SDF definitions through source-connected resident construction, guided by AI domain knowledge and evidence.
checkpoint_reason: No resident construction checkpoint exists in this milestone.
decision: Use a bounded exact-distance language of separated boxes over persistent and scratch memory demand as the first structural construction experiment.

classification.distance_formula: derived Euclidean distance under stated separation conditions

metric: Euclidean in (persistent_bytes/M_ref,scratch_bytes/M_ref), same positive M_ref for both axes.
protected_law: x>=0,y>=0,x+y<=beta; accepted component boxes must satisfy explicit lower-coordinate/quota margins and positive separation.
reason: A single safe axis-aligned region cannot cover both outer demand clusters (.72,.16) and (.16,.72) under beta=1; multiple separated regions provide a checkable reason to construct new structure.
alternatives_considered: Only tuning one box would not meet structural novelty.
A fixed exact quota-triangle SDF would evaluate the quota but would not demonstrate evidence-guided definition construction.
Arbitrary unions or smooth blends would lose the supported exact-distance guarantee.
grammar: At most four BOX leaves and seven postorder BOX/SEPARATED_UNION nodes; current constructor proposal uses a left-associated append form.
representation: New opcodes and child references will be mutable per-instance state, interpreted by current situated resident methods; native function bank remains stable.
fixed_truth: Units, packed-constant geometry checks, quota, objective and independent oracle must not drift to accept a candidate.
outcome: Foundation validated; resident construction, acceptance, feedback intervention, checkpoint continuation and useful task comparison still pending.
next_decision: Split larger numerical bindings to fit the unchanged 256-instruction XIR limit, then connect constructor and evaluator roles into the source graph.

evidence_observed: The initial combined geometry binding exceeded 256 XIR instructions; no resident application program was claimed or installed.
decision: Use separate per-component and separation validation, and staged runtime AST interpretation; retain the existing arithmetic and expression limits.
reason: This preserves bounded, inspectable resident execution and keeps program data on the resident action path while providing compact graph calls.
baseline: Four recorded source graph editions must reproduce their original v2 program bytes; extension compilation and invalid contract checks are separate.
predeclared_acceptance: No more than256 expression instructions,64 inputs and32 outputs per binding.
Malformed live AST data must reject rather than silently normalize.
Candidate geometric failure must be distinguished from corrupted retained program data.
Reference comparisons must preserve declared domain/metric and tolerances.
outcome: Binding revision and direct probes in progress; no full resident construction claim.
next_decision: Use compilation/probe evidence to choose the graph wiring, then measure actual retained AST and behavioral changes.
